title: Customer concern verification and guided support
summary: This topic combines service notes about verifying customer concerns with advisor guidance for setup or troubleshooting, with only a few fragments stating concrete problems.

negative.summary: Negative fragments describe confirmed faults during diagnosis and abnormally noisy wiper blades.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mainly record concern verification, customer guidance, subscription or enrollment help, and isolated customer statements without a clear evaluative outcome.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including diagnostic verification, digital feature guidance, purchase-choice context, and a customer worry about engine behavior.
Most fragments are terse service-note language, so sentiment and outcomes are often unclear.
Examples are insufficient to determine a consistent issue beyond the broad pattern of verified concerns and guided assistance.
